stimulus:  (a) Unless you study attentively .  (b) Walk fast lest .  (c) He will swim after .  (d) Danger often comes where .  (e) We should take a rest so that .
guide_solution: (a) Unless you study attentively, you cannot cut a good figure in the exam. (b) Walk fast lest you should/might miss the train. (c) He will swim after completing his homework. (d) Danger often comes where danger is feared. (e) We should take a rest so that we can restore our energy.

guide_solution: (a) Unless you study attentively you will fail in the exam. (b) Walk fast lest you should miss the train. (c) He will swim after finishing his breakfast. (d) Danger often comes where danger is feared. (e) We should take a rest so that we can restore our energy.
